description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five training methods—'Standard,' 'Self-RAG,' 'FactTune,' 'ClInGS (w/),' and 'ClInGS'—on 11 datasets, with methods ordered along the horizontal axis in ascending order of performance. The vertical axis, labeled 'Average Performance,' ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. The 'ClInGS' method achieves the highest performance, with a value of approximately 62, significantly outperforming all other methods. The 'ClInGS (w/)' variant follows closely with a performance of about 55. The 'Self-RAG' method shows a slight decrease compared to the 'Standard' method, which maintains a stable performance of around 53. 'FactTune' exhibits the lowest performance, at approximately 48. The chart highlights the superior effectiveness of the 'ClInGS' approach, particularly the standalone version, which demonstrates a notable improvement over its variant.
